messages:
maria: Heads up — multiple customers reporting 401s after today's key rotation. Tickets from acme-inc + brightlane. First seen ~11:12 UTC. Error: 'invalid_token' from /introspect. Anyone on call?

alex: I'm on it. Seeing spike in auth-service 401s and token-mapper 500s. Correlates with rotation job at 11:10 UTC. Pulling logs now.

incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered — Auth-Service oncall (sev: 2).

jae: Logs show repeated errors: `failed to fetch jwks: context deadline exceeded` from token-mapper. Looks like JWKS fetch to keymanager timed out.

samira: KMS metrics show a short 429 burst at 11:09–11:11 UTC. We pushed rotation-worker canary at 11:08 — possible thundering retries to KMS.

alex: Workaround idea: flip active key back to previous version and enable a rotation-fallback flag so token-mapper accepts cached JWKS while fetch fails. Need infra help to flip.

jae: I can hotfix token-mapper to fallback to cached keys while fetch errors. Also recommend flushing token cache after we stabilize:
```
# flush token cache safely
redis-cli -n 2 --scan --pattern 'tokencache:*' | xargs -n 100 redis-cli -n 2 del
```

maria: Customer impact: hosted API requests returning 401s; Dedicated tenants hitting introspect 401s too. CS already sending interim updates.

cs-bot: Notifying impacted customers (acme-inc, brightlane) with templated message. ETA for mitigation: ~30m.

alex: We've switched the active key back to v2 (rollback). Observability shows validation succeeding again and 401 rate trending down to baseline.

jae: Action items for RCA: add exponential backoff + jitter on JWKS/KMS fetch, add preflight check before marking a new key active, and add a canary rate limiter for rotation workers.

samira: Opening KMS support ticket and increasing rotation-worker connection pool limits. Also adding short delay between worker retries.

maria: Thanks — CS will hold customer updates until you confirm fully stable. Please post final RCA. :thumbsup:

alex: I'll open the incident ticket and assign RCA to jae.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-453 — "Auth key rotation propagation failed; impact window 11:10–11:25 UTC".

jae: Quick repro steps for eng (staging): 1) force rotation job; 2) simulate KMS 429 using toxiproxy; 3) observe token-mapper fallback. Example:
```
# simulate 429 to KMS
toxiproxy-cli toxic add --to keymanager --type latency --attributes 'timeout=5000'
# run rotation in staging
./scripts/rotate-keys --env=staging
# tail token-mapper logs
kubectl logs -l app=token-mapper -c token-mapper -f
```

maria: Great, capturing these steps in the incident doc. Will follow up with CS notes and impacted customer list.

alex: Monitoring for an hour. If anything flares, ping me and I'll re-open pager.

samira: I'll post KMS ticket id in the doc once I have it.

maria: Thanks everyone. Keeping channel open for any late fallout."
